documents.title: Linear Pricing & Plans
documents.content: Linear offers a Free plan for small teams up to 250 active issues. The Standard plan is $8 per user per month billed annually ($10 monthly), offering unlimited issues, guest accounts, and integrations. The Plus plan is $14 per user per month with SOC 2 Type II compliance, advanced admin roles, and SAML SSO.
